metadata.description: Lowercase prefix used for Azure resources and Windows computer names.
Stable within one lab lifetime and regenerated after teardown to avoid soft-deleted Key Vault name collisions.
Base tags applied to all scenario resources.
Required deployer IPv4 CIDR. A /32 is expected and becomes the only public DNAT source.
Additional explicit IPv4 CIDRs used by runners whose Azure-bound traffic exits through different addresses than general internet traffic.
Applies the approved SecurityControl=Ignore tagging contract to scenario resources. Lifecycle automation is expected to tag the resource group separately when the exemption path is used.
Azure Migrate physical appliance currently requires 8 vCPU, 32 GB RAM, and 80 GB disk or greater.
Temporarily permits authenticated deployer and firewall-egress access to Key Vault and Storage. Lifecycle cleanup is expected to disable it in finally.

copy.name: validatedAdditionalDeployerAddressPrefixes
copy.input: [if(contains(parameters('additionalDeployerAddressPrefixes')[copyIndex('validatedAdditionalDeployerAddressPrefixes')], ':'), fail('additionalDeployerAddressPrefixes entries must be IPv4 CIDRs.'), format('{0}/{1}', parseCidr(parameters('additionalDeployerAddressPrefixes')[copyIndex('validatedAdditionalDeployerAddressPrefixes')]).network, parseCidr(parameters('additionalDeployerAddressPrefixes')[copyIndex('validatedAdditionalDeployerAddressPrefixes')]).cidr))]

variables.deployerAddressCidr: [if(contains(parameters('deployerAddressPrefix'), ':'), fail('deployerAddressPrefix must be an IPv4 CIDR, typically /32.'), parseCidr(parameters('deployerAddressPrefix')))]
